future_check: Keep distribution legality and oracle executability reported separately for any future negative recombination probes.
rationale: The canonical program selects the first seed found and can execute some missing/duplicate-seed inputs. Oracle non-crash is not lesson legality, so structural self_check owns this boundary.
summary: Malformed recombinations are rejected by the teaching distribution even when the Racket oracle can execute them.

future_check: If the generic mutation gate gains task-declared lawful color symmetries, declare 2↔3 explicitly and require all other relevant structural mutations to reject.
rationale: Distance equality does not distinguish which seed is called red versus green. That generic mutation is therefore not destructive for this task and should not be used as evidence of self_check weakness; blank/missing/duplicate/foreign-color/disconnected fixtures are the meaningful structural checks.
summary: Generic swap-two-colors mutation accepts the 2↔3 seed swap because the equality predicate is symmetric.

future_check: If wall topology is ever promoted to a public axis, add it only with exact observation, full boundary probing, and schedule-identifiability tests that remain valid under overrides.
rationale: The old generator advertised many semantic controls that were inert or unobservable. Only dimensions are now exact overrides; the four wall profiles rotate by sample_index so every three-demo window includes a wall-sensitive counterexample without misleading override metadata.
summary: Wall topology is a deterministic lesson schedule, not a public exact override axis.

future_check: Keep selected canonical and target_code exact-synchronized after future rule edits; archival raw_code may remain commentless only while execution parity continues to pass.
rationale: The active task-local target contains useful comments while the canonical text was commentless. Comment-stripped texts already matched and execution parity passed, so canonical was moved toward the clearer selected source rather than deleting comments.
summary: Canonical Racket text was synchronized to the task-local selected target without changing behavior.

future_check: Retain wall-sensitive witnesses in every lesson window so future generator simplification cannot silently collapse back to a Manhattan-only curriculum.
rationale: It fits canonical no-wall pair 0 and wall pair 1 where the wall happens not to alter the bisector, but generated gate scenes force BFS detours and disagree with Manhattan distance.
summary: Wall-blind Manhattan distance is a plausible shortcut but not the task rule.
